content: Game drops! Minecraft Dungeons II! Big news! More! Minecraft LIVE is back! Watch the community pre-show then learn about everything happening in the wide world of Minecraft in this jam-packed Minecraft LIVE! Tune in on September 26th at 10am PT / 1pm ET / 6pm BST / 7pm CEST.
